items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Well, I used to like to hear Willard Turner, Tuma at least.

ctx.x: Who were your favorite clarinet players? Anyone in particular that you can remember that you liked when you were young or you played with?
Well, I used to like to hear Willard Turner, Tuma at least.
What's the name again? Tuma, Will Tuma. Will.
